verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an AI agent (Rudder AI in Slack), so asking whether that agent can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only documents RudderStack's own MCP server, which external clients like Claude, Cursor and VS Code connect to. That is the server role, not the ability to plug third-party MCP servers into RudderStack, and nothing in the pack shows client-side MCP support.
